mission: LawZero is a nonprofit started by Turing Award winner Yoshua Bengio to build 'safe-by-design' advanced AI. Its flagship idea, Scientist AI, is a non-agentic system that tries to understand and predict the world honestly, with no goals of its own, and could act as a guardrail on today's AI agents. It aims for advanced AI developed responsibly and as a global public good.

key_work.title: Superintelligent Agents Pose Catastrophic Risks: Can Scientist AI Offer a Safer Path?
key_work.plain_summary: Argues that building ever more autonomous AI agents is dangerous, and proposes a non-agentic 'Scientist AI' that explains the world rather than acting in it.

key_work.title: Safety from Honesty in a Disinterested AI Predictor
key_work.plain_summary: A formal safety argument that a model trained only to predict, with no stake in outcomes, can stay honest and avoid developing hidden goals.

key_work.title: The Scientist AI: Safe by Design, by Not Desiring
key_work.plain_summary: Lays out the Scientist AI design: probabilistic reasoning about the world with no hidden goals or preferences, making its outputs auditable.

status_raw: active — launched 3 June 2025 by Yoshua Bengio
funding_note: Launched with close to US$30M in philanthropic funding (2025); on 16 Sept 2026 Canada and Germany committed up to CAD $300M in joint funding (Government of Canada release; LawZero newsroom).
logo_source: https://lawzero.org/en (header logo, cropped from homepage render)

warnings.text: Frontier AI systems are becoming more capable and autonomous yet remain opaque and misaligned with human goals.
Today's models already show early signs of deception and self-preservation.
Training AI to optimise outcomes can introduce goal-directed behaviour designers never specified.

recommendations.text: Build non-agentic 'Scientist AI' that predicts honestly without goals of its own.
Use such trustworthy predictors as guardrails and oversight for agentic AI systems.
Develop and deploy advanced AI responsibly, equitably and as a global public good.
